newsitem.title: USA: Aon unit to buy ERA Home Warranty business.
newsitem.headline: Aon unit to buy ERA Home Warranty business.

text.p: Aon Corp said Tuesday that its Aon Warranty Group Inc subsidiary agreed to buy the ERA Home Warranty business from HFS Inc
HFS is the world's largest franchisor of hotels and residential real estate.

Under a 10-year preferred vendor agreement, Aon Warranty will continue to expand the ERA Home Warranty program and produce new home warranty products for HFS brands CENTURY 21 and Coldwell Banker. Aon Warranty will retain the current ERA Home Warranty Plan for ERA member brokers, updating and improving it over time.
Aon said this relationship will augment the companies' long-term arrangement, under which Aon Warranty markets extended warranty products to all HFS franchises.
Home warranties offer protection from certain types of mechanical breakdowns for the period immediately following the purchase of a home.

"The ERA Home Warranty program, which is a highly respected provider of home warranty products, will complement the many warranty products that we offer our clients," David Cole, chairman of Aon Warranty Group, said in a statement.

"Through its subsidiaries, Aon has long been a major supplier of insurance products and services to our 16,000 franchised outlets, and we believe that our preferred vendor agreement will add value for our many franchisees," John Snodgrass, president of HFS, added.
The ERA Home Warranty business was a component of an acquisition by HFS, earlier this year, of the ERA residential real estate franchise system.
